exposure: hospital level at which caesarean section was performed
closed cervix prior to caesarean section
cohort: 121 women with caesarean scar defects identified by transvaginal ultrasound
finding: Cesarean scar defect-associated postmenstrual spotting was associated with a retroflexed uterus, closed cervix prior to caesarean delivery and caesarean delivery performed at a town/county-level hospital compared to a province-level hospital.
